title: 第10课 · 我能坐这儿吗
subtitle: HSK 1 · Lesson 10 — 我能坐这儿吗 · Can I sit here

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在办公室 — In the office

items.zh: B：桌子上有一个电脑和一本书。
items.py: B: Zhuōzi shang yǒu yí ge diànnǎo hé yì běn shū.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在健身房 — In the gym

items.zh: A：前面那个人叫什么名字？
items.py: A: Qiánmiàn nàge rén jiào shénme míngzi?
items.en: A: Who is the person in front?

items.py: B: Tā jiào Wáng Fāng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
items.en: B: She is Wang Fang. She works in a hospital.

items.zh: A：后面那个人呢？他叫什么名字？
items.py: A: Hòumiàn nàge rén ne? Tā jiào shénme míngzi?
items.en: A: And the person at the back? What's his name?

items.py: B: Tā jiào Xiè Péng, zài shāngdiàn gōngzuò.
items.en: B: He is Xie Peng. He works in a store.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在图书馆 — In the library

items.py: A: Wǒ néng zuò zhèr ma?

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (“有”字句：表示存在)

items.py: Yǐzi xiàmiàn yǒu yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
items.en: There is a puppy under the chair.

items.py: Xuéxiào li yǒu yí ge shāngdiàn.
items.en: There is a shop in the school.

items.zh: 桌子上有一个电脑和一本书。
items.py: Zhuōzi shang yǒu yí ge diànnǎo hé yì běn shū.
items.en: There is a computer and a book on the desk.
There is no puppy under the chair.

items.py: Zhuōzi shang méiyǒu diànnǎo hé shū.
items.en: There is no computer or book on the desk.

items.zh: 我有一个中国朋友和一个美国朋友。
items.py: Wǒ yǒu yí ge Zhōngguó péngyou hé yí ge Měiguó péngyou.
items.en: I have a Chinese friend and an American friend.

items.zh: 我家有三口人，爸爸、妈妈和我。
items.py: Wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén, bàba, māma hé wǒ.
items.en: There are three of us: dad, mum and me.

items.py: Míngtiān xiàwǔ wǒ néng qù shāngdiàn.
items.en: I can go to the shop tomorrow afternoon.

items.zh: 你能在这儿写你的名字吗？
items.py: Nǐ néng zài zhèr xiě nǐ de míngzi ma?
items.en: Can you write your name here?

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (用“请”的祈使句)

items.zh: 中国人的名字：姓在前，名字在后。
items.py: Zhōngguórén de míngzi: xìng zài qián, míngzi zài hòu.
items.en: Chinese names: family name first, given name after.

items.py: Lǐ Yuè: Lǐ shì xìng, Yuè shì míngzi.
items.en: Li Yue: Li is the family name, Yue the given name.

items.zh: 张、王、李、赵是最常见的姓。
items.py: Zhāng, Wáng, Lǐ, Zhào shì zuì chángjiàn de xìng.
items.en: Zhang, Wang, Li and Zhao are the most common family names.
Ouyang, Shangguan and Zhuge are two-character family names.
Address people as family name + job: Teacher Li, Doctor Wang.
